quality: Pointwise two-sided95% Wilson upper endpoint, z=1.959963984540054, one2^26 denominator per API/geometry. No pooling across rounds, batches, aliases, API families, sizes or historical observations
quality_records: 81 unpooled API/geometry records with correlated common seed/negative streams; no claim of81 independent constructions
rank_separately: Each round, size, batch, actual-byte cap, FPR ceiling and metric. Four query and four build contracts are never combined
owner_mapping: Frozen plan owner external→retained_external; native_experimental→optional_native_range; all other exact owners retained. nested_caps: Admit every selected point whose actual bytes*8 <= real_n*cap, including allocations measured under smaller declared budgets. Cross-budget leaders are cross-process comparisons within the same round, not necessarily one-process pairs
selection: Within each owner/group and view choose minimum quality-eligible median; retain all tie winners by exact reported median, all alternatives, quality failures and missing comparators. No eligible rival means no-comparable, not a win
contrasts: Keep Poppy/strongest retained external, Poppy/production, Poppy/optional Range, Poppy/optional K12 and Poppy/composite native. Also production/strongest all-external, optional Range/strongest all-external, optional K12/strongest all-external and composite native/strongest all-external. Nine named contrasts per same view/contract; missing quality-eligible comparators remain no-comparable
ratio: Numerator latency / denominator latency; below1 faster, above1 slower. Always print direction. Retain every loss and exact tie
round_pairs: For every exact API/size/actual-byte/batch/metric, retain round2/round1 and both source positions. These paired reversed-schedule observations do not isolate order effects because calibration/cache/thermal history differs
prior_data: Prior432 views selected the fixed32 strong control points only; import no historical latency. Prior public Poppy quality is an exact semantic reproduction requirement, not a second independent denominator
retention: Every47 fitting Poppy source mapping remains even if quality fails. Keep both excluded33-bpk canonical choices in the prior selection ledger, not in memory-eligible speed rankings. Preserve all486 rows,1944 query vectors/15552 values and1944 build medians
uncertainty: Seen inputseed42, two reversed schedules, repeated nested views and per-process repetitions are descriptive; no fresh-seed, independent-significance, universal-fastest, external-MT or multithread-native claim
public_cost: Eight-byte public preparation, mandatory Poppy secondary hash/cache/bucket work and insertion result handling remain charged. These public API costs must not be relabeled as a prehashed core bitmap comparison
decision: Report scoped wins/losses and eligibility. No quality-selected seed, geometry retuning, control replacement, post-result extension or automatic production promotion
